title: Should I Run the Triple Crown?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown is a huge opportunity for racers in their classic year. Mejiro Palmer is having trouble deciding whether to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't want to embarrass herself and become a laughingstock. However, she has also always dreamed of the Triple Crown and doesn't want to skip it either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After much deliberation, we decide to check in on how she feels before each Classic Triple Crown race. If she feels like running, we'll enter the race.
